recent_posts.title: Reuna Presenter - Multi-screen projection software for churches, in the browser
recent_posts.summary: Reuna Presenter is a browser-based church presentation app built as a web alternative to ProPresenter and EasyWorship. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, and TypeScript in a Turborepo monorepo, it supports multi-screen projection with independent content per display, a stage monitor view, drag-and-drop service planning, a cloud song library, Bible integration with offline support, mobile remote control via QR code, MIDI cue triggers, and responsive templates using container query units. The solo developer is offering 10 days of PRO access to church tech teams willing to test it in a live Sunday service.

recent_posts.title: I built a headless React hook for multi-step forms with conditional branching, Zod validation, and persistence
recent_posts.summary: FormFlow is a headless React hook library for building multi-step forms with conditional branching, per-step Zod validation, and pluggable persistence (localStorage, sessionStorage, URL params, or custom). The API centers on a single `useFormFlow` hook that accepts steps as plain objects, supports TypeScript, and has zero UI dependencies so developers retain full rendering control. It can be installed via pnpm and includes an interactive demo site.

recent_posts.title: Most Icons Are Static. These 200+ Are Not
recent_posts.summary: AnimateIcons is a React library offering 200+ animated SVG icons designed for UI micro-interactions. It integrates with shadcn/ui via CLI, adds icons directly to your codebase without runtime dependencies, and supports hover-based, controlled, and programmatic animations. The library focuses on purposeful motion for modern interfaces rather than decorative effects.

recent_posts.title: Generate mockups from images or website URL
recent_posts.summary: Mocku.co is a tool that automatically generates realistic device mockups from screenshots or website URLs. It supports desktop and mobile device frames, offers multiple styling options, can create video mockups, and includes AI-powered editing capabilities through a chat interface.

recent_posts.title: Why be late, when Nityasha is here?
recent_posts.summary: Nityasha is an AI-powered personal assistant that integrates with Notion to streamline workflows through automated note management, task organization, research assistance, and image search capabilities.

recent_posts.title: Static is boring — animate your icons 🎯
recent_posts.summary: AnimateIcons is a React library that transforms static SVG icons into smooth animations. It offers 45+ animated icons, works with React and Next.js, supports hover and programmatic control, and integrates with ShadCN CLI. The library aims to enhance user interfaces by adding purposeful motion to icons.

recent_posts.title: Roast My Galaxy Folio
recent_posts.summary: A developer shares their experience building an interactive 3D portfolio website using Three.js and React Three Fiber. The project features multiple immersive scenes, particle systems, custom animations, and interactive 3D objects. Despite facing challenges with performance optimization and browser compatibility, the developer successfully created a space-themed portfolio that runs smoothly across devices. They plan to sell it as a template for other developers.

recent_posts.title: Typographic Design & POV Concept
recent_posts.summary: Typography is essential for effective communication. Good typographic design creates visual harmony, improves readability, and sets the mood. A typeface is a family of fonts, and choosing the right font pair, usually a contrast of serif and sans-serif, helps establish hierarchy and visual interest. Point of View (POV) in design shapes user interaction, emotion, and engagement by guiding the user's eye and creating a visual journey.
